description: Change Cloudflare zone settings for a moved domain. Only an allowlist is editable (ssl, always_use_https, automatic_https_rewrites, min_tls_version, development_mode, cache_level) — WAF/firewall/security controls are deliberately not exposed. Prefer ssl `full` over `flexible`: `flexible` makes Cloudflare fetch the origin over plain HTTP, a downgrade the visitor cannot see. CLOUDFLARE_REAUTHORIZE_REQUIRED means the stored authorization lacks this permission — surface the connectUrl and ask the customer to reconnect. Supports dry_run.

domain.description: Domain whose zone settings to change.

ssl.description: TLS mode between Cloudflare and the origin. `full` is the safe default.

name: set_cloudflare_zone_settings
title: Set Cloudflare Zone Settings
